title: Cold Case Review: Data Basics
subtitle: Speed test your World 1 skills before moving on!
conceptSummary: You've mastered: tables, SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, and data types. World 2 awaits!

dialogue.text: Before we head to SQL Streets, let's make sure your basics are locked in. Speed round time!
10 questions. Prove you're ready. No pressure. (There's pressure.)

task.instruction: Answer 10 quick questions about what you've learned. Pick the correct answer fast!

options: You have millions of rows and multiple tables

winDialogue.text: You passed! World 1 badge unlocked. SQL Streets, here we come!
Don't celebrate yet. SQL Streets is where the real work begins. SHADOW42 won't catch itself.

storyBeat: World 1 complete! You've proven your data reading skills. The SHADOW42 trail leads to SQL Streets — where complex queries will crack the case wide open.
